## Overview

Fix streaming derender for Tekken-based Mistral tokenizers, where a byte-fallback token in the decode window breaks the client-carried `stream_state`.

The `/v1/responses` corruption originally reported here was fixed by #65118; this PR only covers the derender endpoints.

## Claims

- Streaming `/v1/completions/derender` and `/v1/chat/completions/derender` keep working when the decode window contains a byte-fallback token instead of rejecting the request.
- With a parser configured, chat derender for `MistralTokenizer` now uses the request's `skip_special_tokens`, matching serving after #65118.


## Validation

### Unit test

```shell
python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py -v

# 124 passed, 1 xfailed in 76.12s
```

### E2E test

#### Server:

```shell
vllm serve mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B \
  --config-format mistral \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --reasoning-parser mistral \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser mistral \
  --load-format mistral
```

#### Client:

**req.json**

```json
{
  "model": "mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B",
  "stream": false,
  "max_output_tokens": 100,
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get current weather for a location",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"location": {"type": "string"}, "unit": {"type": "string"}},
        "required": ["location"]
      }
    }
  ],
  "input": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "서울의 날씨가 어때?"},
    {"type": "function_call", "call_id": "udM7soqYx", "name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{\"location\":\"서울\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"},
    {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": "udM7soqYx", "output": "서울의 현재 날씨: 22°C, 맑음, 습도 60%"}
  ]
}
```

**Request**

```shell
curl -s http://localhost:8000/v1/responses -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d@/tmp/req.json | jq .output[0].content
```

#### Result:

- main: `[{"text": "사용자가 \"서울의 날씨가 어���?\"라고 물어��고, get_weather 함수를 호출해서 ...`
- PR: `[{"text": "사용자가 \"서울의 날씨가 어때?\"라고 물어봤고, get_weather 함수를 호출해서 ...`

## Details

- Root cause: `MistralTokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens` returns raw `bytes` for byte-fallback tokens. This happens with `skip_special_tokens=True` too, so it already affects `main`. Streaming derender stored those pieces in `DerenderStreamState.prev_tokens: list[str]`, which goes through JSON between chunks. An incomplete UTF-8 piece can't be carried there.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [ ] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

> Thanks, the fix works, but introduced a regression - derender (--enable-scale-out) now returns 400 when the prompt ends in a byte-fallback token, e.g. "맑습니다". DerenderStreamState.prev_tokens is list[str] but now gets bytes. Main returns 200.
> 
> Suggestion: store the window token ids in the state instead of pieces, and type convert_ids_to_tokens as list[str | bytes] instead of using cast.

Thank you for the review! Indeed I haven't covered the derender path, which is fixed in 4bb0c14.

And I have tried to resolve your worry on `cast` in 21fb354 and onwards. It seems typing `convert_ids_to_tokens` as `list[str | bytes]` spreads to `convert_tokens_to_string`, the detokenizer_utils signatures, and new casts in `kimi_audio` and `kanana_v even though only Tekken produces bytes, so is this the direction you want, or would you prefer to keep the cast in `MistralTokenizer` and limit this PR to the token id state change?

> 
> And I have tried to resolve your worry on `cast` in [21fb354](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/21fb354cf7a0b8d87b7fd8402cbdc984dc3af7e4) and onwards. It seems typing `convert_ids_to_tokens` as `list[str | bytes]` spreads to `convert_tokens_to_string`, the detokenizer_utils signatures, and new casts in `kimi_audio` and `kanana_v even though only Tekken produces bytes, so is this the direction you want, or would you prefer to keep the cast in `MistralTokenizer` and limit this PR to the token id state change?

Thanks for the quick fix, the token id state looks good. Seeing the diff, I agree the str | bytes typing spreads too far for a Tekken-only case. Let's please keep the cast in MistralTokenizer.
Rebased and rescoped after #64743. Title and PR body are updated accordingly.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks, the fix works, but introduced a regression - derender (--enable-scale-out) now returns 400 when the prompt ends in a byte-fallback token, e.g. "맑습니다". DerenderStreamState.prev_tokens is list[str] but now gets bytes. Main returns 200.

Suggestion: store the window token ids in the state instead of pieces, and type convert_ids_to_tokens as list[str | bytes] instead of using cast.

For responses I think the real fix is to not use skip special tokens = False IMO
I'm iterating on something like this https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/65118

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks, the fix works, but introduced a regression - derender (--enable-scale-out) now returns 400 when the prompt ends in a byte-fallback token, e.g. "맑습니다". DerenderStreamState.prev_tokens is list[str] but now gets bytes. Main returns 200.

Suggestion: store the window token ids in the state instead of pieces, and type convert_ids_to_tokens as list[str | bytes] instead of using cast.

For responses I think the real fix is to not use skip special tokens = False IMO
I'm iterating on something like this https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/65118
